ein.rationale: EIN is a header/envelope attribute in MeF and does not appear as a leaf element in the IRS990N body candidates list.

organization_name.rationale: BusinessNameLine1Txt under BusinessName is the primary legal name of the organization.

organization_name_change.rationale: No name-change indicator element exists in the candidate list for IRS990N; this checkbox is not represented as a canonical leaf element.

doing_business_as.rationale: BusinessNameLine1Txt under DoingBusinessAsName captures the DBA trade name of the organization.

address_change.rationale: No address-change indicator element exists in the candidate list for IRS990N.

mailing_address_line1.rationale: The organization's mailing address is not present as a distinct set of candidates; all USAddress and ForeignAddress xpath candidates are under the principal officer context — blueprint should clarify whether organization address fields exist separately in the schema.

mailing_address_line2.rationale: Same as mailing_address_line1 — no separate organization mailing address candidates are present in the list.

mailing_city.rationale: Same as mailing_address_line1 — no separate organization mailing city candidate is present.

mailing_state.rationale: Same as mailing_address_line1 — no separate organization mailing state candidate is present.

mailing_zip.rationale: Same as mailing_address_line1 — no separate organization mailing ZIP candidate is present.

mailing_country.rationale: Same as mailing_address_line1 — no separate organization mailing country candidate is present.

website_url.rationale: WebsiteAddressTxt directly corresponds to the organization's website URL field (line E).

principal_officer_name.rationale: PersonNm is the canonical element for the principal officer's full name under section F.

principal_officer_address_same_as_org.rationale: No same-as-organization address indicator element exists in the candidate list.

principal_officer_address_line1.rationale: AddressLine1Txt under USAddress matches the principal officer's US street address line 1.

principal_officer_address_line2.rationale: AddressLine2Txt under USAddress matches the principal officer's US street address line 2.

principal_officer_city.rationale: CityNm under USAddress matches the principal officer's US city.

principal_officer_state.rationale: StateAbbreviationCd under USAddress matches the principal officer's US state abbreviation.

principal_officer_zip.rationale: ZIPCd under USAddress matches the principal officer's ZIP code.

principal_officer_country.rationale: CountryCd under ForeignAddress is the best match for a foreign country on the principal officer's address; blueprint should note this only applies when address is foreign.

tax_period_begin_date.rationale: Tax period begin date is an envelope/header element in MeF and does not appear as a leaf candidate in the IRS990N body.

tax_period_end_date.rationale: Tax period end date is an envelope/header element in MeF and does not appear as a leaf candidate in the IRS990N body.

gross_receipts_under_threshold.rationale: GrossReceiptsLimitInd directly corresponds to the attestation that gross receipts are normally $50,000 or less.

organization_terminated.rationale: FinalReturnInd corresponds to the termination/final return checkbox on the e-Postcard (line B).

organization_type.rationale: No IRC exemption type/organization type element exists in the candidate list for IRS990N.

submission_date.rationale: Submission date is an MeF transmission/acknowledgment attribute, not a body element in IRS990N candidates.

confirmation_number.rationale: Confirmation/submission ID is assigned by the MeF system at the envelope level and does not appear as a leaf element in IRS990N body candidates.
